provenance.notes: SYN: Windows 11 JA4T 64240_2-1-3-1-1-4_1460_8 is published by FoxIO (github.com/FoxIO-LLC/ja4 README). Option order matches p0f's NT 6.x entries (p0f's own Windows 7/8 window is 8192; 64240 is the Windows 10/11 value). Not yet captured from our own devices. IP ID host counter: Windows is known for sequential IDs, not confirmed on current builds. Retransmits 1, 3, 7, 15 s: observed on Windows 10 by Catchpoint docs; Thales documents a 3 s initial RTO and 2 retransmits, so sources disagree. Window scale dropped from the 2nd retransmission: Clavister KB (two SYNs with it, one without); p0f lists mss,nop,nop,sok for the no-scale layout. Re-capture with `lb-fptest tcp-capture --flow` and set status to captured.
